source_text.body:
Pull portfolio holdings into Claude via an MCP server
A user connected a portfolio tracker's MCP server so Claude retrieves holdings and transactions on demand instead of manual uploads.
·
Apr 7, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster stopped manually uploading brokerage statements and instead connected a portfolio tracker app that exposes an MCP server. They logged accounts in through Plaid or By All Accounts, and their understanding is that Claude now calls the app’s API to pull holdings and transactions on demand; the person still double-checks the advice.
How it went
They said the advice felt more relevant than before, but gave no hard performance numbers. The main downside they reported was the initial setup effort, and they were still verifying the output rather than trusting it outright.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is setup friction: connecting each institution through Plaid or alternatives took extra effort up front.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using my connected [portfolio tracker] tool, pull my current holdings and transactions from [start date] to today. Summarize my positions, total return, biggest gainers and losers, and any trades that look unusual or duplicated. Finish with a one-page overview and a list of questions you'd want answered before suggesting changes.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1s0ofjl/anyone_else_using_an_mcp_to_get_financial_advice
